salon.title: Your salon
salon.lead: Your customers see this information on the booking page.
salon.name: Salon name
salon.slugWarning: If you change the link, printed QR codes and shared links stop working.
salon.slugOwnerOnly: Only the owner can change the link.
salon.privacyTextHint: Shown on your booking page if you give no link above (the link takes precedence). Simple formatting: # heading, - list, **bold**.
salon.privacyTemplateHint: Filled in with your details. You must complete the places marked [BITTE PRÜFEN] and have the text checked before you save.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.lead: When is your salon open? You can enter several time spans per day, e.g. with a lunch break.

booking.title: Booking rules
booking.lead: How customers can book with you.
booking.slotIntervalHint: Start times are offered at this interval.
booking.autoConfirmHint: Without the tick you confirm every request yourself.
booking.minLeadHint: How close to the appointment a booking is still allowed. Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.
booking.horizonHint: How far ahead customers can book. Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.
booking.cancellationHint: Customers can cancel themselves up to this many hours before the appointment. Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.
booking.requestExpiryHint: An unanswered request expires after this time. Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.
booking.retentionHint: Customers without appointments are anonymized afterwards. Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.

closures.title: Closed days
closures.lead: Public holidays and company holidays: nobody can book on these days.
closures.endDateHint: For several days in a row.

security.title: Security
security.lead: A second factor keeps your account safe even if someone knows your password. You need an authenticator app on your phone.
security.scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator).
security.qrAlt: QR code to connect the authenticator app
security.manual: Or type this key in by hand:
security.codesHint: Keep them safe, ideally printed or in a password manager. Each code lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. They are only shown now.
security.copyFailed: Copying is not possible. Select the codes and copy them by hand.
security.passwordHint: To turn it off or get new recovery codes, confirm with your password. The old codes then stop working.
